text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, pant*... Trainer, thank you 
so much!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I gave it everything I had! 
With this...
choice_data_list: We can definitely make it to the Classics!
We can definitely make it to the Classics!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yes...!! It feels like a dream. To think 
I'm standing on the stage I've always 
longed for!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
If I train more and make full preparations 
from here on, maybe in the actual race...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
McQueen isn't here. So if I can just go 
into this feeling stronger than I ever 
have before...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hurriedly headed out to check the 
racetrack outside.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At that moment, the central screen showed 
footage from another racetrack.

text_block_list.name: TV Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“She's strong! So strong! A dominant 
runaway victory! The chasing pack couldn't 
even catch her shadow!”

text_block_list.name: TV Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"The winner is Ines Fujin! Ines Fujin 
takes it!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Umm, everyone might just be focusing on 
the Mejiro girls, but I'm not gonna lose♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
As the famous Mejiro Ryan's roommate, no 
one knows her running better than me!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm super pumped for the first Classic 
leg! See ya at the Satsuki Sho! ...From 
Friend A.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Projected on the screen was Ines Fujin, 
having scored an overwhelming victory at 
another racetrack...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Though spoken in a cheerful tone, it was 
unequivocally—a challenge."
